pr_title: [ML] Conditionally send the dimensions field as part of the openai requests
pr_comments: Hi @jonathan-buttner, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: [ML] Support the `dimensions` option for 3rd gen OpenAI text embedding models
issue_context.body:
### Description

The new `text-embedding-3-small` and `text-embedding-3-large` model are available for use in the Inference API (v8.12) by configuring the `model` parameter to one of those models. The OpenAI text embedding API now has a `dimensions` option for those models to specify the number of dimensions in the response vectors. The same option should be available in the inference API.

review_comments: Happy to rename this. I couldn't think of a good name. Maybe `getRedactedXContentObject`?
Filtered is good. The purpose is to hide implementation details and that shouldn't be confused with hiding secrets settings which is what redacted suggests to me.
Since this test passes `true` for `should_return_hidden_field` we should see it in the response
Sigh, these should have been moved. There mostly the same as before but I did add a few test cases around the dimensions behavior.
Returns an `XContentObject` removing the fields that should not be exposed.

The `dimensions` field should always be set when ready from the persistent settings. But since we're allowing null we'll leave it that way just in case. We'll check for null in a few places to handle it.

Not needed for this PR, but we should think about contributing/moving this interface to a package which is usable anywhere in elasticsearch as its very general and I imagine other people would like something like this
is there a reason all of these tests use PERSISTENT?
Yeah not really, I'll move the logic that relies on the context into a static function and test that.
why does this one have a different access modifier than the other ones?
Good point, I'll switch `ORGANIZATION` to be package private. `NAME` needs to be public because it's used in a separate package when registering the named writeable registry.
Ensures that `service_settings` does not have the `hidden_field`.

I believe `dimensions` is really a embeddings thing so I moved moved the service settings to be embedding settings.

We're stuck with `OpenAiEmbeddingsServiceSettings.NAME` the way it was before though.
